title: Slovakian Baked Dumplings with Bryndza Cheese
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring baked dumplings topped with a creamy bryndza cheese sauce. Perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: In a pan, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in the bryndza cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake the dumplings in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the baked dumplings topped with the bryndza cheese sauce.
